text_sanskrit: इति क्षेत्रं तथा ज्ञानं ज्ञेयं चोक्तं समासतः । मद्भक्त एतद्विज्ञाय मद्भावायोपपद्यते ॥ १३-१९ ॥
itrans: iti kShetra.n tathA j~nAnaM j~neya.n chokta.n samAsataH . madbhakta etadvij~nAya madbhAvAyopapadyate .. 13-19 ..
translation: Thus, Kshetra as well as Knowledge and the Thing to be known have been briefly declared; My devotee having well understood this becomes fit to take his stand on Me.
